Connect interactions between charts in an HTML document

Source: R/hc_connect.R
hc_connect.Rd

Apply this helper to each widget, including widgets rendered in separate Quarto HTML chunks. Each widget keeps its own data. The first X axis is used for hover and zoom. Points are matched by their exact numeric X value (including timestamps). Category axes should have the same category order. A missing match clears the receiving tooltip and crosshair.

Usage

hc_connect(hc, group, sync = c("hover", "zoom"))

Arguments

hc

A highchart widget.

group

A non-empty group name shared by the charts on the page.

sync

Interactions to share. "hover" links tooltips and crosshairs, "zoom" links X ranges and reset buttons, and "legend" links series or pie points with the same explicit id. Enable an interaction on both widgets.

Value

The highchart widget.

Examples

# Fictional monthly sales. Matching series IDs link the legends.
cafes <- list(
  list(id = "harbor", name = "Harbor", data = c(12, 15, 18, 16, 22, 25)),
  list(id = "garden", name = "Garden", data = c(18, 16, 14, 19, 21, 23)),
  list(id = "station", name = "Station", data = c(9, 12, 16, 21, 18, 24))
)
base <- highchart() |>
  hc_add_series_list(cafes) |>
  hc_xAxis(categories = month.abb[1:6], crosshair = TRUE) |>
  hc_yAxis(title = list(text = "Sales (thousands of dollars)")) |>
  hc_tooltip(shared = TRUE, table = TRUE, valueDecimals = 0,
             valuePrefix = "$", valueSuffix = "k") |>
  hc_connect("cafes", sync = c("hover", "zoom", "legend")) |>
  hc_size(height = 320)

# Hover a month, click a legend item, or drag to zoom in either chart.
trends <- base |>
  hc_chart(type = "line") |>
  hc_title(text = "Coffee around town") |>
  hc_subtitle(text = "Hover, toggle a cafe, or drag to zoom")
sales <- base |>
  hc_chart(type = "column") |>
  hc_title(text = "The same sales, another view") |>
  hc_plotOptions(column = list(
    borderRadius = 4,
    dataLabels = list(enabled = TRUE)
  )) |>
  hc_caption(text = "Legends, tooltips and zoom are linked in both directions.")
htmltools::browsable(htmltools::tagList(trends, sales))
